effective_row.label: RBA Broad money — Seasonally adjusted
effective_row.source_contract: Broad money, seasonally adjusted, monthly, AUD billions
effective_row.append_contract: append only strictly contiguous monthly observations after the stored PIT runtime tail; normalize new official RBA observations to one decimal to preserve the existing runtime scale; current-vintage revisions to stored dates are diagnostic only and can never rewrite historical runtime values

reason: The exact RBA D3 broad-money series DMABMS is identified and live-tested. The current vintage contains substantial historical revisions relative to the stored point-in-time runtime: 127 overlapping months, 48 matching after the runtime's one-decimal normalization and 79 revised. Therefore the automation contract is explicitly revision-aware and append-only. CI run 38403392393 proved a safe append of 2026-08 = 3510.1 after ROUND_1DP normalization on an ephemeral runtime copy while leaving the full existing historical prefix unchanged. Tracked runtime remained unchanged and no publication occurred.
